mde-garden-11.see: An outdoor garden courtyard with a grass lawn, potted citrus trees, two stone flowerbeds, a water urn on a wooden stand, and an octagonal fountain adjoins an indoor room visible across an arched doorway.
mde-garden-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-garden-11.wrong: An untextured flat grey-blue square polygon clips over and covers the fountain basin (as well as the fountain in the adjoining room), two disconnected rooms are visible across a partition wall, and the lower area extends into an empty black void grid.

mde-hammam-11.see: A tiled marble bathhouse contains a central octagonal fountain, marble benches topped with wooden bath clogs and folded striped towels, two wall-mounted ablution sinks with brass basins, and a wooden entrance door.
mde-hammam-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Ottoman / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-hammam-11.wrong: An untextured flat grey-blue square plane floats over and clips into the central fountain basin, a bright yellow-green bar artifacts across the top edge, and an empty black void surrounds the room.

mde-souk-11.see: A compact merchant stall features a wooden counter with a balance scale, brass bowls, a stool, and a bolster cushion, set in front of tall wooden shelving stocked with pottery, urns, and metal flagons.
mde-souk-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-souk-11.focal: Wooden merchant counter with balance scale
mde-souk-11.wrong: Severe clipping between the counter, shelves, and doorframe walls in an overly tight footprint, with a wall lantern clipping into shelving and black void visible outside the walls.

mde-courtyard-11.see: A large cobblestone courtyard holds stacked cargo packs and bedrolls, terracotta water jars on wooden stands, an isolated hitching rail, and an octagonal fountain, abutting a partition wall that opens into a carpeted interior lounge.
mde-courtyard-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-courtyard-11.focal: Cobblestone yard with central octagonal fountain
mde-courtyard-11.wrong: A flat grey-blue square plane floats over and clips into the fountain basin (repeated on the background fountain), the wooden hitching rail sits isolated near the edge of the floor, and the frame shows two separate rooms bordering empty black space.

mde-coffee-11.see: A stone-paved sitting lounge contains three round brass tea tables with teapots and cups, a central stack of floor cushions, a striped woven rug, a water jug on a stand, and cushioned perimeter divans set into arched wall niches.
mde-coffee-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-coffee-11.focal: Cluster of low brass tea tables and floor cushions
mde-coffee-11.wrong: A bright yellow-green horizontal bar artifacts across the top of the image, the wall lantern on the left appears mounted flat with no hanging bracket, and the room sits on an empty black background.

mde-audience-11.see: A formal reception room is lined with cushioned divans and mashrabiya lattice windows, centered around an ornate oriental rug bearing an octagonal stone fountain and a small brass tea table.
mde-audience-11.culture: Middle Eastern / Islamic, medieval to early modern
mde-audience-11.focal: Central oriental rug with octagonal fountain
mde-audience-11.wrong: A flat untextured grey-blue square plane clips directly over the octagonal fountain basin, a bright yellow-green bar artifacts along the top edge, the left wall lantern has no visible hanging wire, and the exterior is an empty black void grid.
